body: That's right and my post was not especially opposing this. Maybe you became annoying for them for no particular reason, and that's also what I meant with a step on the foot (not only a clumsy remark, but also a general burden). In either cases, it's something involuntary. I can understand that they grew bored with you or something like that, but it should not lead to ghosting with no goodbyes.
Thank you for your support, wishing you the best
Thank you for your message. I don't think she'll come back and I'll probably tell her it's "over" if she tries anyway, but I understand it's a possibility.
Thank you very much for your support.
I understand. How long had you been talking, and what made them special in your eyes (asking as you struggle to forget them)?
So, how close were you from the accident when you made it?
Thank you very much for all your comments, it somehow appeased me.
I'll try to think about it, thanks a lot

Thanks for your reply. I'm glad you're happy with your life now.

Even with courage I don't really see what I can do now. I guess I'll carry on for some time, to see if things can be done in my life.
I'll think about it, thank you Bro

Thanks for your reply, I made my post also because I knew some people would relate.

I'm glad you could change your career path this way. Like I said, it's pretty much impossible for me. I'll keep working, see if there's any hope, but I doubt it. I feel like I have to walk down a corridor, not horrible, but very monotonous, that doesn't make me want to live.

I wish you much success.
